2025arXiv250721270M.title: Generative imaging for radio interferometry with fast uncertainty quantification

uncertainty_correlation_details.scope: GU-Net RI-GAN; per-pixel uncertainty (std across 32 posterior samples) vs |x_true − x_pred|

execution_context.error_reference: Absolute reconstruction error vs ground truth
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (galaxy images; OOD 30 Doradus also discussed for SNR)

uncertainty_correlation_details.evidence: Uncertainty–error correlation (UQ calibration proxy): Pearson correlation between per-pixel predicted uncertainty (std across samples) and per-pixel absolute reconstruction error |x_true − x_pred|. With 32 posterior samples, GU-Net RI-GAN reaches r = 0.69 (U-Net RI-GAN r = 0.58).

uncertainty_correlation_details.scope: GU-Net vs plain U-Net RI-GAN uncertainty–error correlation (32 samples)

execution_context.error_reference: Absolute reconstruction error vs ground truth

uncertainty_correlation_details.evidence: GU-Net uncertainty maps track true error better than the plain U-Net variant: r = 0.69 vs r = 0.58 at 32 samples.

uncertainty_correlation_details.scope: Number-of-samples ablation for uncertainty–error correlation (and SNR)

execution_context.uncertainty_source: Per-pixel std across N posterior samples
execution_context.error_reference: Absolute reconstruction error vs ground truth

uncertainty_correlation_details.evidence: Both SNR and the uncertainty–error correlation improve as the number of posterior samples increases and plateau around 32 samples; low sample counts give markedly lower correlation (interpreted as evidence of sample diversity / no mode collapse).
